## Published-consumer dependency correction

- Corrected the flattened public POM shape so standalone consumers receive Jackson 2.21.6,
  Jackson 3.1.6, and Log4j 2.25.5 floors where those runtime families are present.
- Adopted the compatible released dependency train: Claude Code SDK 1.5.0, Agent Journal and
  Claude capture 1.7.0, and Agent Sandbox Core 0.10.0.
- Added a generated no-parent/no-BOM consumer gate for every published runtime-bearing module and
  made ordinary CI enforce its complete dependency matrix.
- Removed exported snapshot and milestone repository declarations from flattened consumer POMs.
- Added one parent-attached CycloneDX 1.6 JSON aggregate SBOM and embedded the current BSL 1.1 text
  plus retained Apache history in published archives.
- Updated current owned-source headers to reference the repository-root license while preserving
  the historical Apache release boundary.

Agent Client 0.26.0 remains immutable. This release is the fixed-forward correction for its
standalone published-consumer dependency graph; it does not claim that 0.26.0 was rebuilt or
repaired in place.
